lessons.title: Introduction to Organic Chemistry
lessons.focus: Define organic chemistry, discuss its importance, and overview of carbon's unique bonding properties.

lessons.title: Structure of Carbon Compounds
lessons.focus: Explain covalent bonding, hybridization (sp, sp2, sp3), and basic molecular geometry.

lessons.title: Functional Groups I: Hydrocarbons
lessons.focus: Identify alkanes, alkenes, alkynes; naming rules; basic properties and reactions.

lessons.title: Functional Groups II: Halogenated Compounds and Alcohols
lessons.focus: Introduce alkyl halides and alcohols, naming, physical properties, and typical reactions.

lessons.title: Functional Groups III: Carbonyl Compounds
lessons.focus: Cover aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, esters, and amides; naming and key reactions.

lessons.title: Isomerism
lessons.focus: Explain structural, geometric (cis/trans), and optical isomerism with examples.

lessons.title: Reaction Mechanisms Basics
lessons.focus: Introduce arrows, nucleophiles, electrophiles, and stepwise mechanisms for substitution and addition.

lessons.title: Key Organic Reactions I: Substitution
lessons.focus: Detail SN1, SN2, and electrophilic aromatic substitution mechanisms and conditions.

lessons.title: Key Organic Reactions II: Addition and Elimination
lessons.focus: Cover addition to alkenes/alkynes, elimination (E1, E2), and factors influencing each.

lessons.title: Synthesis and Spectroscopy Overview
lessons.focus: Show how to plan simple syntheses and introduce IR, NMR, and mass spectrometry for structure identification.
